streamlet:
    image: ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/server:0.2.0
    environment:
      STREAMLET_ADDR: "0.0.0.0:3000"
      STREAMLET_VALHALLA_URL: "http://valhalla:8002"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:2510:3000"
    depends_on:
      valhalla:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 150m
        limits:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 150m
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.streamlet.rule=Host(`streamlet.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.streamlet.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
  valhalla:
    image: ghcr.io/valhalla/valhalla-scripted:3.9.0
    volumes:
      - ./.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files:/custom_files
    environment:
      server_threads: 20
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "curl",
          "--silent",
          "--fail-with-body",
          "--max-time",
          "5",
          "http://localhost:8002/status",
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          cpus: "1"
          memory: 256m
        limits:
          cpus: "2"
          memory: 1536m
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.valhalla.rule=Host(`valhalla.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.valhalla.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
  reverse-proxy:
    image: traefik:v3.7.13
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      - PORKBUN_API_KEY=${PORKBUN_API_KEY:-}
      - PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY=${PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY:-}
    ports:
      - "${BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:3000:3000/tcp"
      - "${BIND_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}:3443:3443/tcp"
    volumes:
      - "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/${TRAEFIK_CONFIG:-traefik.yaml}:/etc/traefik/traefik.yaml:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/dynamic:/etc/traefik/dynamic:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/certs:/etc/traefik/certs:ro"
      - "./.docker/infra/traefik/acme:/etc/traefik/acme"
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.rule=Host(`traefik.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.traefik.service=traefik"
      - "traefik.http.services.traefik.loadbalancer.server.port=8080"

  backend:
